when.quote: When a customer needs to file a formal dispute for a credit card transaction (such as unauthorized charges, merchant issues, or billing errors), the agent must gather comprehensive information and call the file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829 tool.

starts.note: customer: start only when the customer asks to dispute a credit card charge. Never file a dispute the customer did not ask for. Order a replacement card only if the customer asks for the card to be cancelled and replaced. Provisional credit is never a separate action: it is decided for each dispute and passed in that dispute's eligible_for_provisional_credit flag.
starts.quote: However, if you've already tried contacting the merchant without success, or if the charge appears to be fraudulent, please don't hesitate to reach out to us right away.

tools.not_used: Not used in this job. Provisional credit is recorded only through the dispute's eligible_for_provisional_credit flag. No dispute document says to post a statement credit when a dispute is filed. This tool is for goodwill credits, fee reversals and similar adjustments, and for credits after a dispute is resolved.

info.about: One of unauthorized_fraudulent_charge, duplicate_charge, incorrect_amount, goods_services_not_received, goods_services_not_as_described, canceled_subscription_still_charging or refund_never_processed. Getting something different from what was paid for (for example, a different or cheaper room or item) is goods_services_not_as_described. A charge repeated a second time is duplicate_charge.
info.ask: Which of these best describes the problem: an unauthorized or fraudulent charge, a duplicate charge, an incorrect amount, goods or services not received, goods or services not as described, a cancelled subscription that is still charging, or a refund that was never processed?

info.about: The date the customer noticed the issue, as MM/DD/YYYY. If the customer says 'today', get the date from get_current_time. Never guess a date.

info.about: One of full_refund, partial_refund (needs partial_refund_amount) or reversal_of_charge
info.ask: Which resolution would you like: a full refund, a partial refund (and how much), or a reversal of the charge?

info.about: The dollar amount, needed only if resolution_requested is partial_refund

info.about: keep_active, or cancel_and_reissue if the customer wants the card replaced. Ask once per card when several cards are involved.

Needed only for cancel_and_reissue with a replacement order: the confirmed shipping address (the address on file, or an alternate such as a work address, with suite or unit), the replacement reason (fraud_suspected, lost, stolen, damaged, expired or other) and the shipping speed (standard, or expedited with any tier fee)
info.ask: Where should we ship the replacement card, what is the reason for the replacement, and would you like standard or expedited shipping?

steps.do: Greet the customer and ask for identifying details. Look them up with get_user_information_by_email if they give an email, get_user_information_by_name (case-sensitive) if they give a name, or get_user_information_by_id if they give a user id.
steps.quote: To verify the identity of the user, call the appropriate read tools, and ensure that they are able to give correctly any 2 out of the following values: date of birth, email, phone number, address.

steps.do: Confirm that at least 2 of date of birth, email, phone and address match the record from lookup_user. Share no account information before they match. If they do not match, ask again. If verification still fails, stop.
steps.quote: Knowing full name or userID is not enough to verify.

steps.do: Get the current time. Use it for the verification log, for any date the customer gives as 'today', and to work out account age and purchase age.
steps.quote: If you need the current time, always use the get_current_time() tool.

steps.do: Log the verification.

steps.quote: After verification, you must call the verification logging tool to properly log the information into the verification records.

steps.do: Get the user's credit card accounts. Note each one's card type (tier), account id and open date.

steps.do: Get the user's card transactions and find each disputed one by merchant and amount. This gives its transaction_id and purchase_date.

From the record, take the transaction_id, the exact amount, the purchase date (MM/DD/YYYY) and the card account it was made on. If nothing matches, ask for more detail. If it still cannot be found, explain that the dispute cannot be filed without the transaction, and stop.
steps.quote: 10. purchase_date (string, format MM/DD/YYYY) - The date in which the disputed transaction occurred.

steps.do: Group the disputed transactions by the card account each was made on (identify_transaction, get_accounts). For each card, use its own card type for the provisional credit tier maximum. Ask for its last 4 digits once (ask_last4) and its card_action once (ask_card_action). Use these card-level values for every dispute on that card. Never apply one card's values to a transaction on another card.
steps.if: the disputed transactions are on more than one of the customer's cards
steps.quote: Last 4 digits of the credit card under which the disputed transaction took place.

steps.do: When the customer disputes more than one transaction, handle each one separately: identify_transaction, ask_reason, ask_merchant, ask_noticed, ask_resolution and decide_provisional, then one file_dispute call per transaction_id. Each dispute gets its own reason, merchant-contact answer and provisional credit decision. Use the same card_action for every dispute on the same card.
steps.if: the customer wants to dispute more than one transaction
steps.quote: 1. transaction_id (string) - ID of the transaction being disputed.

steps.do: Have the customer choose the dispute reason from the allowed values. Paid for one thing and received a different or cheaper one: goods_services_not_as_described. Never received it: goods_services_not_received. Charged a different amount than expected: incorrect_amount. Charge the customer did not make: unauthorized_fraudulent_charge. Subscription cancelled but still charging: canceled_subscription_still_charging. Promised refund never applied: refund_never_processed.

If any order is pending or shipped, the customer is not eligible: explain that the current replacement must be delivered or cancelled first, and do not order. If the tier limit is exceeded (Entry 2, Mid 3, Premium and above 4 per 60 days), the customer is also not eligible: offer a manual review.

Confirm the shipping speed: expedited fee by tier, with consent; strongly recommend expedited for fraud_suspected or stolen. steps.do: Read the dispute history once, in check_dispute_history, and count the disputes dated in the past 12 months, measured against get_time. Add 1 to the count for each dispute filed successfully earlier in this conversation. Before each filing, use this running count for the previous-disputes criterion: the dispute meets it only if the count is 2 or less.
steps.if: more than one dispute is being filed in this conversation
steps.quote: 4. Previous Disputes: The customer has not filed more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months

steps.do: Decide eligible_for_provisional_credit using the Provisional Credit Eligibility Guidelines. Every criterion must hold: (1) The account has been open at least 60 days (open date from get_accounts compared with get_time). (2) The reason is unauthorized_fraudulent_charge or duplicate_charge, or it is goods_services_not_received with the purchase made more than 30 days ago. (3) The amount is at least $25.00 and no more than the maximum for the tier of the card the transaction is on. (4) No more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months (check_dispute_history, or running_dispute_count when several disputes are filed). (5) For a reason other than fraud, the merchant was contacted. If any criterion fails, set it to false.
steps.quote: 15. eligible_for_provisional_credit (boolean) - Agent must determine this based on the Provisional Credit Eligibility Guidelines article in this knowledge base. Pass true or false.

steps.do: Ask which of the disputes the customer most wants handled first, unless they have already said. Do not explain the internal eligibility rules.
steps.if: several disputes meet criteria (1), (2), (3) and (5), the running count leaves room for fewer of them than that, and the customer has not yet said which matter most
steps.quote: 4. Previous Disputes: The customer has not filed more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months

steps.do: Set the filing order. First file the disputes that meet criteria (1), (2), (3) and (5), starting with the ones the customer named as most important (ask_priority). Then file all the other disputes. Before each filing, recompute criterion (4) from running_dispute_count and set that dispute's eligible_for_provisional_credit again.
steps.if: several disputes are being filed and more of them meet criteria (1), (2), (3) and (5) than the running count allows
steps.quote: 4. Previous Disputes: The customer has not filed more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months

rules.rule: Provisional credit is true only if ALL of these hold: (1) the account has been open at least 60 days; (2) the reason is unauthorized_fraudulent_charge or duplicate_charge, or it is goods_services_not_received with the purchase made more than 30 days ago; (3) the amount is at least $25.00 and no more than the tier maximum; (4) no more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months; (5) for a non-fraud dispute, the merchant was contacted first
rules.quote: ## Eligibility Criteria — Customer is ELIGIBLE for provisional credit if ALL of the following are true:

rules.rule: The reasons incorrect_amount, goods_services_not_as_described, canceled_subscription_still_charging and refund_never_processed are never eligible for provisional credit
rules.quote: - Dispute reason is 'incorrect_amount', 'goods_services_not_as_described', 'canceled_subscription_still_charging', or 'refund_never_processed'

rules.rule: Mid-tier cards (Silver Rewards, Business Silver Rewards, Green Rewards, Silver Zoom) have a provisional credit maximum of $5000.00. Other tiers: Entry $2500, Premium $10000, Elite $15000, Diamond Elite $25000.
rules.quote: - Mid Tier (Silver Rewards Card, Business Silver Rewards Card, Green Rewards Card, Silver Zoom Card): Maximum $5000.00

rules.rule: Entry-tier cards (Bronze Rewards, EcoCard, Business Bronze Rewards, Crypto-Cash Back) have a provisional credit maximum of $2500.00
rules.quote: Entry Tier (Bronze Rewards Card, EcoCard, Business Bronze Rewards Card, Crypto-Cash Back Card): Maximum $2500.00

rules.rule: Premium-tier cards (Gold Rewards, Business Gold Rewards) have a provisional credit maximum of $10000.00
rules.quote: Premium Tier (Gold Rewards Card, Business Gold Rewards Card): Maximum $10000.00

rules.rule: Elite-tier cards (Platinum Rewards, Business Platinum Rewards) have a provisional credit maximum of $15000.00
rules.quote: Elite Tier (Platinum Rewards Card, Business Platinum Rewards Card): Maximum $15000.00

rules.rule: The Invitation-tier card (Diamond Elite) has a provisional credit maximum of $25000.00
rules.quote: Invitation Tier (Diamond Elite Card): Maximum $25000.00

rules.rule: Use cancel_and_reissue only when the customer wants the card replaced; otherwise use keep_active
rules.quote: - 'cancel_and_reissue': The card is being cancelled and a replacement issued (use when user wants card replaced - whether you've already ordered a replacement card via order_replacement_credit_card_7291 or the cancellation is happening as part of this dispute)

rules.quote: 14. partial_refund_amount (number, optional) - Only required if resolution_requested is 'partial_refund'. The dollar amount for the partial refund.

rules.rule: If the customer does not have the last 4 digits, give them the get_card_last_4_digits user tool instead of walking them through the steps
rules.quote: - Providing this tool replaces any step‑by‑step process for obtaining the last four digits.

rules.rule: Provisional credit requires the credit card account to have been open at least 60 days (open date from get_credit_card_accounts_by_user, compared with get_current_time)
rules.quote: 1. Account Standing: The customer's credit card account has been open for at least 60 days

rules.rule: goods_services_not_received is eligible only when the purchase was made more than 30 days ago
rules.quote: 'goods_services_not_received' (only if purchase was made more than 30 days ago)

rules.rule: The transaction amount must be >= $25.00 and <= the maximum for the tier of the card it is on
rules.quote: 3. Dispute Amount: The transaction amount must be at least $25.00 and must not exceed the card's maximum provisional credit limit based on card tier (see below)

rules.rule: Not eligible if the customer filed more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months (from get_user_dispute_history_7291). When several disputes are filed in one conversation, count those already filed in it too: a dispute meets this criterion only if the running count is 2 or less when it is filed.
rules.quote: 4. Previous Disputes: The customer has not filed more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months

rules.rule: For any reason other than unauthorized_fraudulent_charge, provisional credit requires contacted_merchant = true
rules.quote: 5. Contacted Merchant: For non-fraud disputes (anything other than 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge'), the customer must have attempted to resolve with the merchant first

jobs.done_when: All of the following hold. The customer is verified and the verification is logged. file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829 has been called successfully once for each confirmed transaction in the records, on every card involved, with all required arguments. Each call carries that card's last 4 digits and the customer's card_action for that card, plus an eligible_for_provisional_credit value decided for that dispute, using the running dispute count and the order from the customer's priorities when several disputes are filed. If the customer chose cancel_and_reissue and was eligible, a replacement was ordered. Charges not found in the records were explained and not disputed. The customer has been told that each dispute is filed and whether provisional credit applies. If filing failed, the failure has been explained instead and a transfer offered.

info.about: One reason per transaction: unauthorized_fraudulent_charge, duplicate_charge, incorrect_amount, goods_services_not_received, goods_services_not_as_described, canceled_subscription_still_charging or refund_never_processed
info.ask: What is the problem with this charge? Is it unauthorized, a duplicate, the wrong amount, something you never received, something not as described, a subscription you cancelled that is still charging, or a refund that was never processed?

info.about: Whether the customer tried to resolve the charge with the merchant first. Ask for every transaction.
info.ask: Did you try to resolve this with the merchant first?

info.about: When the customer noticed the issue, in MM/DD/YYYY. If the customer says 'today', use the date from get_current_time. Never guess.
info.ask: When did you first notice this issue?

info.about: full_refund, partial_refund (which also needs partial_refund_amount) or reversal_of_charge
info.ask: What resolution would you like: a full refund, a partial refund, or a reversal of the charge?

info.about: Only when resolution_requested is partial_refund
info.ask: What amount would you like refunded?

info.about: Whether the customer wants to keep each card active or have it cancelled and replaced
info.ask: Would you like to keep this card active, or cancel it and have a replacement issued?

info.about: If only some disputes can get provisional credit, the order the customer wants them filed in
info.ask: Which of these disputes matter most to you to resolve first?

steps.do: Ask for the customer's full name or email and the charges they want to dispute. Do not share any account information before verification.
steps.quote: Verify the customer's identity using standard verification procedures.

steps.do: Look up the customer with get_user_information_by_name (or by_email / by_id). Ask for 2 of: date of birth, email, phone, address. Confirm both match the record. If they do not match, do not continue.
steps.quote: Verify the customer's identity using standard verification procedures.

steps.do: Get the current time. It is used for the verification log, for issue_noticed_date when the customer says 'today', and for the 30-day not-received rule.
steps.quote: 11. issue_noticed_date (string, format MM/DD/YYYY) - Ask user when they noticed the issue.

steps.do: Log the verification. Use the record's name, user_id, address, email, phone and date of birth, and the time from get_time.
steps.if: the customer gave 2 matching identity values
steps.quote: Verify the customer's identity using standard verification procedures.

steps.do: Get the customer's credit card accounts. From each account read the card type (which sets the tier), the last 4 digits, the account id and the open date (for account age).
steps.quote: 1. Account Standing: The customer's credit card account has been open for at least 60 days

steps.do: Get the customer's credit card transactions. Match each charge the customer named (card, merchant, amount, date) to its transaction_id, purchase date and amount. If a charge cannot be found, tell the customer and ask them to clarify it.
steps.quote: 1. transaction_id (string) - ID of the transaction being disputed.

steps.do: Unlock get_user_dispute_history_7291.
steps.quote: To retrieve a user's credit card dispute history, use the get_user_dispute_history_7291 tool.

steps.do: Call get_user_dispute_history_7291 and count the disputes dated in the past 12 months (compare to get_time). Keep this count and add 1 for each dispute filed in this conversation.
steps.quote: 4. Previous Disputes: The customer has not filed more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months

steps.do: For each transaction, ask for any of these the customer has not given: dispute_reason (map their description to exactly one allowed value), contacted_merchant, issue_noticed_date, resolution_requested (and partial_refund_amount if partial). Ask about contacted_merchant even for fraud. If the customer says they noticed the issue 'today', use the date from get_time.
steps.quote: 9. contacted_merchant (boolean) - Ask user: Did you try to resolve this with the merchant first? Pass true or false

steps.do: Ask whether the customer wants to keep each card active or cancel and reissue it. Set card_action to 'keep_active' if they keep the card. Set it to 'cancel_and_reissue' if they want it replaced. Record the choice per card and use it for every dispute on that card.
steps.quote: 'keep_active': Keep the card active, just dispute this charge (use when user wants to continue using their current card)

steps.do: Only if the customer wants a card replaced: confirm the shipping address, the reason (fraud_suspected, lost, stolen, damaged, expired or other) and the shipping speed. Expedited fees: Entry $15.00, Mid $10.00, Premium and above $0.00. Recommend expedited for fraud. Then unlock and call order_replacement_credit_card_7291 with the account id from get_accounts. The old card is cancelled automatically.

args.expedited_fee_acknowledgement: customer consent if a fee applies

steps.if: the customer asked for the card to be cancelled and replaced (card_action 'cancel_and_reissue')
steps.quote: Use unlock_discoverable_agent_tool with tool_name: order_replacement_credit_card_7291.

steps.do: For each dispute, set eligible_for_provisional_credit to true only if ALL of these hold: (1) the card account is at least 60 days old (from get_accounts and get_time). (2) The reason is unauthorized_fraudulent_charge, duplicate_charge, or goods_services_not_received with a purchase date more than 30 days before today. (3) The amount is at least $25.00 and no more than the card tier's maximum. (4) The running count of disputes filed in the past 12 months, from get_dispute_history plus those already filed in this conversation, is no more than 2. (5) For any reason other than fraud, contacted_merchant is true. Otherwise set it to false.
steps.quote: 15. eligible_for_provisional_credit (boolean) - Agent must determine this based on the Provisional Credit Eligibility Guidelines article in this knowledge base. Pass true or false.

steps.do: The previous-disputes limit means only the first eligible disputes filed can get provisional credit. If the customer has said which disputes matter most, file the provisional-credit-eligible ones they named first. Then file the rest. Re-check criterion (4) before each filing.
steps.if: more disputes would meet criteria 1-3 and 5 than criterion 4 allows
steps.quote: 4. Previous Disputes: The customer has not filed more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months

steps.do: Unlock file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829 once.
steps.if: the customer has confirmed at least one transaction to dispute and every required field for it has been gathered
steps.quote: First unlock the tool, then call it using call_discoverable_agent_tool with the tool name and a JSON string containing all the required arguments.

steps.do: File one dispute per transaction, in the order from order_disputes. Pass every required argument. Pass partial_refund_amount only when the resolution is partial_refund. After each filing, add 1 to the running dispute count.

args.card_last_4_digits: get_accounts, for the card the transaction is on

steps.if: the customer asked to dispute this transaction, it was found in get_transactions, and all required fields are gathered
steps.quote: When a customer needs to file a formal dispute for a credit card transaction (such as unauthorized charges, merchant issues, or billing errors), the agent must gather comprehensive information and call the file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829 tool.

steps.do: If a filing returns an error, check the arguments against the allowed values and retry once. If it still fails, tell the customer and ask whether they want to be transferred to a human agent. Transfer only if they agree.

args.summary: disputes filed and the one that failed

steps.if: a filing call fails twice and the customer agrees to a transfer
steps.quote: If the issue persists, capture the request context and escalate through internal support channels.

steps.do: Tell the customer which disputes were filed and whether each qualifies for provisional credit. Explain that provisional credit is temporary and is reversed if the dispute is not resolved in their favor. Do not explain the internal eligibility rules in detail.
steps.quote: When you file a dispute with our customer service team, they will let you know whether provisional credit applies to your situation.

rules.rule: Provisional credit needs a card account that is at least 60 days old
rules.quote: 1. Account Standing: The customer's credit card account has been open for at least 60 days

rules.rule: Only unauthorized_fraudulent_charge, duplicate_charge, and goods_services_not_received with a purchase more than 30 days ago can get provisional credit
rules.quote: 'goods_services_not_received' (only if purchase was made more than 30 days ago)

rules.rule: incorrect_amount, goods_services_not_as_described, canceled_subscription_still_charging and refund_never_processed never get provisional credit
rules.quote: Dispute reason is 'incorrect_amount', 'goods_services_not_as_described', 'canceled_subscription_still_charging', or 'refund_never_processed'

rules.rule: The amount must be at least $25.00 and no more than the tier maximum
rules.quote: 3. Dispute Amount: The transaction amount must be at least $25.00 and must not exceed the card's maximum provisional credit limit based on card tier (see below)

rules.rule: Entry tier (Bronze Rewards, EcoCard, Business Bronze Rewards, Crypto-Cash Back): maximum $2500.00
rules.quote: Entry Tier (Bronze Rewards Card, EcoCard, Business Bronze Rewards Card, Crypto-Cash Back Card): Maximum $2500.00

rules.rule: Mid tier: maximum $5000.00
rules.quote: Mid Tier (Silver Rewards Card, Business Silver Rewards Card, Green Rewards Card, Silver Zoom Card): Maximum $5000.00

rules.rule: Premium tier (Gold Rewards, Business Gold Rewards): maximum $10000.00
rules.quote: Premium Tier (Gold Rewards Card, Business Gold Rewards Card): Maximum $10000.00

rules.rule: Elite tier: maximum $15000.00
rules.quote: Elite Tier (Platinum Rewards Card, Business Platinum Rewards Card): Maximum $15000.00

rules.rule: Invitation tier (Diamond Elite): maximum $25000.00
rules.quote: Invitation Tier (Diamond Elite Card): Maximum $25000.00

rules.rule: No provisional credit if the customer has filed more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months. Count the disputes filed earlier in the same conversation.
rules.quote: 4. Previous Disputes: The customer has not filed more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months

rules.rule: For non-fraud disputes, provisional credit needs contacted_merchant = true. Fraud disputes do not.
rules.quote: 5. Contacted Merchant: For non-fraud disputes (anything other than 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge'), the customer must have attempted to resolve with the merchant first

rules.rule: card_action is 'cancel_and_reissue' only when the customer wants the card replaced. Otherwise it is 'keep_active'.
rules.quote: 'cancel_and_reissue': The card is being cancelled and a replacement issued (use when user wants card replaced - whether you've already ordered a replacement card via order_replacement_credit_card_7291 or the cancellation is happening as part of this dispute)

rules.rule: partial_refund_amount is passed only when resolution_requested is partial_refund
rules.quote: 14. partial_refund_amount (number, optional) - Only required if resolution_requested is 'partial_refund'. The dollar amount for the partial refund.

draft.done_when: Every transaction the customer asked to dispute has been filed with file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829, each with its own correct provisional-credit decision. Any requested card replacement has been ordered. The customer has been told the outcome of each dispute.
